items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Norman Granz man was like a gopher. Norman was -- you know, just helped everybody, you know.

ctx.x: Oh, they did play at Billy Berg’s but that was before -- I mean not before then, but Billy Berg’s didn’t start until -- well after the war, maybe ‘46, ’47. As a matter of fact, Manny, nobody ever talks about him, but this man was responsible for bringing all the jazz, especially to Hollywood because I worked for him at the Club Capri at Pico and (Unintelligible) when I was with Lorenzo Flennoy. That’s where when Prez left Basie, that’s where they played. That was the club, that was the joint. As a matter of fact…
Norman Granz man was like a gopher. Norman was -- you know, just helped everybody, you know.
